authority: #K2-410 stop order (convergence stagnation, ~80 rounds without a binary): produce a BINARY - a feasible witness OR a conservation-level infeasibility certificate. No further 'caliber clarification / one more tool version' may occupy a round.

BINARY.verdict: NO FEASIBLE WITNESS WITHIN THE CURRENT MEANS (and not yet proven impossible in principle) => the CONSERVATION-LEVEL BLOCKER REPORT is issued below.

measured_state.stitch_gate: k = 4/8 in-bound (MCU_VDD / NRST / I2C1_SCL), excluded 4 (PERSTA# / P3V3_AUX / I2C1_SDA / P3V3)

the_four_questions.which_layer: the ENDPOINT/PORT layer of the in-register maze (DEAD-END endpoints) plus the FRAME BOUNDARY (C35 wall): each residual pair is a broken net whose two copper fragments end at points the maze cannot start/goal from.
the_four_questions.which_resource: free routing cells inside the block frame that are (a) in the endpoint's own net island and (b) >= the netclass clearance from foreign copper - i.e. reachable endpoint cells, not total area.
the_four_questions.who_occupies_it: (i) foreign-net copper as seen by the maze's own obstacle model (prunes the endpoint cells); and (ii) the frame boundary itself: the wipe cuts each net's copper AT the frame, so the endpoint's remaining copper lies on/outside the wall and no in-domain cell belongs to its island.
the_four_questions.why_no_allocation_is_possible: for the four excluded pairs the two endpoints are separated across the frame (measured pair spans: PERSTA# 2.3mm, P3V3_AUX 0.6mm, I2C1_SDA 5.6mm, P3V3 41.1mm) so a direct stitch necessarily leaves the bound rect (refused), while the maze refuses the endpoints themselves (no free in-island cell) - hence within the current means NO allocation of the in-register tools closes them; the four in-bound pairs ARE closeable (the partial-apply stage now does exactly that).

what_would_be_required_to_reach_C1_zero: a DRAWING-layer change for the four excluded nets: their connectivity must be re-derived INSIDE the domain (the maze must route them within the frame), which requires the endpoint/port capability (C38-class) - NOT another stitch-tool version. This is a PLANNING-layer filing, per #K2-410 sec.4.3.
not_an_owner_matter: no requirement/interface is touched; it is an engineering drawing+tool matter.
